title: The N-run LCP shortcut stops short when two suffixes have equal N remaining
body:
With `--allow-ambiguity`, `find_lcp` in `libsufr/src/build/sort.rs` takes a shortcut when both suffixes start inside a run of N that `find_n_ranges` listed, 1,000 N or more:

```rust
if let (Some(end1), Some(end2)) = (find_n_run(n_ranges, start1), find_n_run(n_ranges, start2)) {
    return T::from_usize(min(end1 - start1, end2 - start2));
}
```

That is the LCP only when the two remaining runs differ in length. When they are equal, the match continues past the runs into whatever follows, and the shortcut stops short.

A record of `ACGT`, 1,200 N, `GATTACATTTT`, 1,200 N, `GATTACA` shows it. `sufr create --dna -a --write-lcp` followed by `sufr list -r -p -s` gives rank 15 (`NGATTACATTTT…`) an LCP of 1 against its neighbour `NGATTACA$`, where the LCP is 8. Ranks 17, 19, 21 and 23 are short by the same 7. A build with the shortcut removed (`n_ranges` left empty) writes the correct values, and the same order: the merge's byte compare at the short LCP sees equal bytes and the order comes out right regardless.

Found by the dry-run fingerprint check in `benchmarks/`, which refused to put the two builds on one board.

## Open

- Whether the shortcut should fall through to a byte compare from `min(end1, end2)` when the remaining runs are equal, which keeps the saving on every unequal pair.
- Whether the search side reads these LCPs anywhere that the short value changes a result.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/5bf3e231
notes.text: On the 10 MiB long-n fixture from benchmarks/, four builds write four different files: head, head with the LCP cache off, head with the merge's skip zeroed, and head with the shortcut off. The shortcut-off build and a build with both the shortcut and the cache off write the same file, so the cache is output-neutral once the shortcut is gone. The other differences are the short LCPs reaching the merge as skip and the cache as entries. Whether the suffix order differs at this size is not checked; on the tiny input only the LCP column differed.
